segments.sn35.75:1.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu … pe … bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn35.75:1.2: “amukasmiṃ, bhante, vihāre aññataro bhikkhu navo appaññāto ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
segments.sn35.75:1.3: Sādhu, bhante, bhagavā yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyā”ti.
segments.sn35.75:2.1: Atha kho bhagavā navavādañca sutvā gilānavādañca,“appaññāto bhikkhū”ti iti viditvā yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami.
segments.sn35.75:2.2: Addasā kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
segments.sn35.75:2.4: Atha kho bhagavā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn35.75:2.7: Nisīdi bhagavā paññatte āsane. Nisajja kho bhagavā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn35.75:2.8: “kacci te, bhikkhu, khamanīyaṃ, kacci yāpanīyaṃ, kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti no abhikkamanti, paṭikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no abhikkamo”ti?
segments.sn35.75:3.1: “Na me, bhante, khamanīyaṃ, na yāpanīyaṃ … pe … na kho maṃ [me (sabbattha)], bhante, attā sīlato upavadatī”ti.
segments.sn35.75:4.1: “No ce kira te, bhikkhu, attā sīlato upavadati, atha kiñca te kukkuccaṃ ko ca vippaṭisāro”ti?
segments.sn35.75:5.1: “Na khvāhaṃ, bhante, sīlavisuddhatthaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmī”ti.
segments.sn35.75:6.1: “No ce kira tvaṃ, bhikkhu, sīlavisuddhatthaṃ mayā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāsi, atha kimatthaṃ carahi tvaṃ, bhikkhu, mayā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāsī”ti?
segments.sn35.75:7.1: “Anupādāparinibbānatthaṃ khvāhaṃ, bhante, bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmī”ti.
segments.sn35.75:8.2: Sādhu kho tvaṃ, bhikkhu, anupādāparinibbānatthaṃ mayā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāsi.
segments.sn35.75:8.3: Anupādāparinibbānattho hi, bhikkhu, mayā dhammo desito.
segments.sn35.75:9.1: “Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, bhikkhu, cakkhu niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn35.75:11.2: “Yaṃ … pe … sotaṃ … ghānaṃ … jivhā … kāyo … mano … manoviññāṇaṃ … manosamphasso … yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn35.75:13.1: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn35.75:15.1: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ –
segments.sn35.75:17.1: “Evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhu, sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmimpi nibbindati … pe … manasmimpi … manoviññāṇepi … manosamphassepi nibbindati.
segments.sn35.75:17.5: Yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tasmimpi nibbindati.
segments.sn35.75:17.6: Nibbindaṃ virajjati; virāgā vimuccati; vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
segments.sn35.75:17.7: ‘Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānātī”ti.
segments.sn35.75:18.2: Attamano so bhikkhu bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandi.
segments.sn35.75:18.3: Imasmiñca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne tassa bhikkhussa anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccīti [vimuccatīti (sabbattha)].

lines: Navopi hi koci paññāto hoti rāhulatthero viya sumanasāmaṇero viya ca, ayaṃ pana navo ceva apaññāto ca.
74-78. Appaññātoti nāmagottato ceva sīlādiguṇehi ca appaññāto avissuto.
